label: Gaelic football - full move catalogue
description: The Gaelic pack plus the goalkeeper's work, kickouts, frees, sideline kicks and penalties, the bounce, dummies, contact play, reactions and celebrations.
notes: Move catalogue for Meshy Text to Motion. forge.py meshy motion --pack gaelic_full generates the clips; forge.py meshy pack --pack gaelic_full writes game_packs/gaelic_full.json.

backpedal.prompt: A Gaelic football player backpedals on a treadmill, facing straight ahead, quick short steps backwards, arms out, the same cycle over and over.

jockey.prompt: A Gaelic football player marks an opponent in place, facing straight ahead the whole time: knees bent, arms out wide, small shuffle steps left and right and back to the start, the same rhythm over and over. The body never turns.
jockey.no_clip: two Meshy takes did not loop cleanly

idle_tired.prompt: A Gaelic football player stands tired, hands on the knees, breathing hard.

bounce.prompt: A Gaelic football player runs on a treadmill, facing straight ahead, bouncing the round ball on the ground with one hand and catching it again, the same cycle over and over.

dummy_hand_pass.prompt: A Gaelic football player shapes to hand pass, swinging the fist, then pulls it back and keeps the ball, stepping the other way.

dummy_solo.prompt: A Gaelic football player shapes to drop the ball for a solo, then pulls it back into the chest and sidesteps.

kick_from_hand_long.prompt: A Gaelic football player kicks a long ball from the hands up the field: run-up, drops the ball, big punt.

outside_boot_kick.prompt: A Gaelic football player kicks with the outside of the right boot, the ball curling away to the right, an outside-of-the-boot point.

hook_kick.prompt: A Gaelic football player snaps a curling kick across the body at goal, the right leg swinging round.

ground_kick.prompt: A Gaelic football player kicks the ball off the ground, soccer style, a low pass.

fisted_clearance.prompt: A Gaelic football player jumps and punches a high ball away with the fist to clear it.

catch_and_turn.prompt: A Gaelic football player catches a ball at the chest, and in one movement turns to face the goal.

contest_high_ball.prompt: A Gaelic football player jumps for a high ball alongside an opponent, both arms up, shoulders bumping in the air.

mark_call.prompt: A Gaelic football player catches a long kick cleanly, then raises one arm to call a mark and stands still holding the ball.

free_from_hand.prompt: A Gaelic football player takes a free from the hands: stands still, steps up and drops the ball onto the foot, kicking it over the bar.

free_from_ground.prompt: A Gaelic football player takes a free off the ground: places the ball, steps back, runs up and kicks it high over the bar.

sideline_kick.prompt: A Gaelic football player takes a sideline kick: places the ball on the line, steps back at an angle and curls it in.

penalty_kick.prompt: A Gaelic football player takes a penalty: places the ball, runs up and strikes it hard and low.

kickout_long.prompt: A Gaelic football player is a goalkeeper taking a long kickout off the tee: long run-up and big kick high up the field.

kickout_short.prompt: A Gaelic football player is a goalkeeper taking a short kickout: chips the ball gently off the tee to a nearby team-mate.

gk_ready.prompt: A Gaelic football player is a goalkeeper in the ready stance: knees bent, hands out, bouncing lightly on the toes.

gk_tip_over.prompt: A Gaelic football player is a goalkeeper leaping backwards to tip a ball over the crossbar.

gk_catch_high.prompt: A Gaelic football player is a goalkeeper jumping to catch a high ball above the head.

gk_low_save.prompt: A Gaelic football player is a goalkeeper diving down to save a low shot with the feet and body.

gk_spread.prompt: A Gaelic football player is a goalkeeper in a one-on-one, rushing out and spreading wide, arms out.

shoulder_charge.prompt: A Gaelic football player gives a fair shoulder charge: running beside an opponent, elbow tucked in, bumps side-on with the shoulder.

block_down.prompt: A Gaelic football player blocks down a kick: throws the body and the hands down in front of a kicker's boot.

hand_block.prompt: A Gaelic football player jumps with both arms straight up to block a kick at goal.

frontal_block.prompt: A Gaelic football player stands square to a runner and stops them with the chest, arms by the side, a frontal block.

strip_ball.prompt: A Gaelic football player reaches in and slaps the ball out of an opponent's grip with one hand.

dispossessed.prompt: A Gaelic football player has the ball knocked out of the hands from the side, reaching after it.

stumble.prompt: A Gaelic football player is shoved hard in the chest from the front: the upper body jolts backwards, takes two staggering steps backwards, then steadies.

hands_on_head.prompt: A Gaelic football player misses a point and puts both hands on the head.

appeal.prompt: A Gaelic football player appeals to the referee with one arm raised.

call_for_ball.prompt: A Gaelic football player raises an arm and calls for the ball.

knee_slide.prompt: A Gaelic football player celebrates a goal by sliding on the knees, arms out.

point_to_crowd.prompt: A Gaelic football player points both fingers at the crowd, shouting.

applaud.prompt: A Gaelic football player applauds the supporters, clapping above the head.
